construction.implementation_origin: Written from scratch in the isolated build directory

shared_schema.input: Exact keys: schema_version=1, synthetic=true, purpose, document, fields. Document: id (SYN- identifier), entity, format, content. Field: name, source, type, required, pii.

formats.government_form_json: Flat object of scalar strings, integers, booleans or null, for requests and applications.
formats.policy_regulation_text: Original policy text with one Label: value per extraction line, for policy documents.

shared_schema.output: schema_version, status (ok or incomplete), synthetic, document_id, entity, fields, missing_fields, source_span_convention, review. Fields contain name/type/required/pii/status/value/source_span/explanation.
shared_schema.errors: One JSON object with schema_version, status=error and a safe plain-language message; exit 2.
shared_schema.validation: One shared validate_input function validates all entity types before extraction. Field conversion enforces string/integer/boolean types without treating booleans as integers. No unknown schema keys or duplicate JSON keys.

cross_stage_handoffs: A single extraction stage receives the validated shared input. Deterministic source indexing and type checks produce a privacy-filtered shared output; there are no downstream decision stages.

behavior.missing_fields: All absent/null/blank requested values are reported. Missing required values yield incomplete; optional missing fields do not. Valid incomplete extraction exits 0.
behavior.spans: Half-open Unicode code-point offsets. Form offsets refer to sorted JSON with two-space indentation and literal Unicode (scalar quotes included). Policy offsets refer to original text, excluding trailing whitespace. Source contents are never echoed.
behavior.privacy: PII values are always redacted after type validation. Unrecognized field names and known sensitive source labels must be marked PII. Public strings are short upper-case codes only. Public field names use a narrow allowlist. Errors never echo source data or paths. Intended only for fabricated fixtures; classification does not guarantee PII discovery.
behavior.explainability: Each field has a source span and plain-language explanation; output explicitly makes no eligibility or service decision and requires human review.
behavior.accessibility: Plain-language structured JSON without color or visual-only meaning, inspired by Section 508; not an accessible user-interface certification.
behavior.synthetic_fixtures: The example uses an invented case ID, explicitly fabricated persona and fictional non-traceable address. Tests include an invented policy and citizen request.
behavior.determinism: No randomness, timestamps, live providers, or optional model calls.

excluded: Production storage, access control and audit infrastructure

test_outcomes.error_cli: Tests verified exit 2 and JSON error output for missing files, wrong argument counts and invalid content.
